valid.name: module-scope const map with inline function value - pre-built, not rebuilt per call

valid.code: class X { static map = { a: function () { return 1; } }; }
valid.name: static class field map with inline function value - pre-built, not flagged
named function reference (not an inline FunctionExpression) - not flagged
key name "transform" at module scope - not flagged because pre-built, not because of the name

valid.code: function build(items) { return items.map(function (x) { return x; }); }
valid.name: inline function callback argument, but call site is NOT inside a loop - not flagged
bare array literal holding an inline function, not passed to any call - not flagged

invalid.code: function build() { return { a: function () { return 1; } }; }
invalid.name: map rebuilt inside a function body on every call - flagged

invalid.code: class X { m() { const map = { a: function () { return 1; } }; return map; } }
invalid.name: map rebuilt inside a method body - flagged

invalid.code: class X { field = { a: function () { return 1; } }; }
invalid.name: non-static instance field rebuilds per instantiation - flagged

invalid.code: function build() { return { transform: function () { return 1; } }; }
invalid.name: key name "transform" inside a rebuilt-per-call map - flagged, no name-based escape

invalid.code: function build() { return { transformAsync: function () { return 1; } }; }
invalid.name: key name "transformAsync" inside a rebuilt-per-call map - flagged, no name-based escape

invalid.code: function build() { return { anyArbitraryKeyName: function () { return 1; } }; }
invalid.name: renaming the property key to an arbitrary name buys no escape - flagged identically

invalid.code: for (const it of items) { process(it, function (x) { return x; }); }
invalid.name: inline function callback argument passed directly to a call inside a for-of loop - flagged (the textbook per-iteration-closure-allocation case)
inline function callback argument inside a while loop - flagged

invalid.code: function build(cond) { return { a: cond ? function (x) { return x; } : function (x) { return -x; } }; }
invalid.name: ternary-branched inline functions as an object value in a rebuilt-per-call map - both branches flagged

invalid.code: function build(handler = function (x) { return x; }) { return handler; }
invalid.name: default-parameter value is an inline function closure - flagged
non-literal dispatch-table construction (Object.fromEntries) inside a loop - flagged

invalid.code: while (hasNext()) { register(new Map([["a", function (x) { return x; }]])); }
invalid.name: non-literal dispatch-table construction (new Map) inside a loop - flagged
